Name: i18n Error Fix for Dark Creatures and Cuties for NiTV
Author: viccallan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fix for the Dark Creatures and Cuties for NiTV the i18n name error for the Rat critter.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]in the translation file[/color]

[code]﻿Dark Creatures And Cuties\[CP]DarkCreatures\i18n\default.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
line 160
"displayNam4e": "Rat",

should be
"displayName4": "Rat", [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Use Mod manager or[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]unzip and drop the unzipped folder into  the Stardew Valley\Mods folder, say yes when it asks if you want to replace the files.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fix for the Dark Creatures and Cuties for NiTV the i18n name error for the Rat critter. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]only required if you have the [/color]
